posts.author: Jason Beck
posts.text: Tigers infield defense didn't do Framber Valdez any favors missing chances to keep Murakami from stepping to plate in opening inning. But ...
posts.jp: Tiger内野陣の守備ミスがFramber Valdezの足を引っ張り、村上宗隆を初回で打席に立たせてしまった。ただし…

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Impressively, Phillies become the first MLB team in 71 years to walk 13 times in a nine-inning game but score only three runs. What a feat. (They won.)

reply_texts.text: In the words of John Hodgman, “Jesus fuck.”
reply_texts.author: eanasir.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Except for the win, this is the most Phillies thing you could have posted.
reply_texts.author: stevenmcnabb.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: shows they really cant hit lol
reply_texts.author: acphila.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Regardless of what happens from from now until the season ends, I'm going to need to see some inspired moves in the off-season. 2027 feels like the year the bottom falls out
reply_texts.author: marcc856.bsky.social

posts.jp: Phillies は71年ぶりにMLBチームとして9回で13四球を選びながら、得点はわずか3。それでも勝った。

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Seven scoreless for Aaron Nola, who has a 2.10 ERA over his last 10 starts (60 innings). What a boost he's given Phillies.

reply_texts.text:
Absolutely.

And going forward, the Phillies 2027 are a MUCH better team with a solid Nola.
reply_texts.author: jrvj1971.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: The Fox Broadcast had him back in for 8…🥴
reply_texts.author: atrain21.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Any reason why he didn't go out for 8th at 80 pitches?
reply_texts.author: melkasinkas.bsky.social

posts.jp: Aaron Nola は7回無失点。ここ10先発（60イニング）で防御率2.10。Philliesの大きな支え。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Pete Crow-Armstrong's 81 RBIs out of the leadoff spot this season set a Cubs record dating to at least 1898, per team historian Ed Hartig. Tonight marked his 6th game this year with at least 10 total bases, tying Nelson Cruz in 2019 for most such games in a single season in MLB history (since 1900)
posts.jp: Pete Crow-Armstrong のリードオフ打者としての81打点は Cubs の1898年以降の記録。今夜の6試合目で10塁打以上、これは2019年の Nelson Cruz と並び MLB 史上最多。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Another multi-homer game for Pete Crow-Armstrong as he goes deep for his second of the night and 44th on the season. His 7th multi-HR game this season. The "M-V-P!" chants follow him around the bases at Wrigley as Cubs take a 7-2 lead in the 7th.
posts.jp: Pete Crow-Armstrong が本塁打！シーズン2本目、通算44号。今季7度目の複数本塁打試合。Wrigley での "M-V-P!" コール。Cubs は7回に7-2とリード。🔴⚪🔵

posts.author: Sam Dykstra
posts.text: Xander Bogaerts has a shot at hitting for the reverse cycle after homering in his first at-bat, tripling in his second and knocking a ground-rule double in his third. The Padres-Rockies game is only in the fourth inning.
posts.jp: Xander Bogaerts は逆サイクルを狙える位置。1打席目は本塁打、2打席目は3塁打、3打席目はグラウンドルール二塁打。Padres-Rockies は4回途中。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: The Orioles beat the Mets, 7-1, to complete a sweep. Baltimore is 75-78 and now 2.5 games back of the Chicago White Sox for the third AL wild card spot with nine games left. Not dead yet. Not exactly heart-healthy, either, but the Orioles have a beat
posts.jp: Orioles が Mets を7-1で倒し、スイープ完了。Baltimore は75-78で AL ワイルドカード第3枠まで2.5ゲーム差、残り9試合。望みはある。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: Pete Alonso, Christian Encarnacion-Strand, and Jeremiah Jackson have all homered in back-to-back games. That's the first time since Aug. 18-19, 2016, that the same three Orioles homered in a two-game span, per to Elias Sports Bureau (Chris Davis, Manny Machado, and Mark Trumbo)
posts.jp: Pete Alonso、Christian Encarnacion-Strand、Jeremiah Jackson が連続試合本塁打。3選手揃うのは2016年8月18-19日以来。当時は Chris Davis、Manny Machado、Mark Trumbo。
